title: KU receives $5.8 million NIH Phase 3 COBRE funding for Chemical Biology of Infectious Disease center
summary_en: The Chemical Biology of Infectious Disease center recruits, mentors and supports investigators across the University of Kansas, KU Medical Center, Kansas State, Wichita State and other regional partners as they address urgent challenges in infectious disease and antibiotic resistance using chemical-biology approaches.
title_cn: KU receives $5.8 million NIH Phase 3 COBRE funding for Chemical Biology of Infectious Disease center

title: Student artists recognized at KU Libraries’ celebration of 2026 LibArt exhibition
summary_en: KU Libraries’ LibArt program, a year-round, juried exhibition of student art displayed throughout library spaces, celebrated a diverse exhibit of student work and recognized award recipients Sept. 17 at a reception in Watson Library.
title_cn: Student artists recognized at KU Libraries’ celebration of 2026 LibArt exhibition

title: Coffeyville teams up with KU to develop long-term community action plan
summary_en: A southeast Kansas school district’s need for a renewed strategic plan was the catalyst for the first Community Futures Planning workshop in Kansas.
title_cn: Coffeyville teams up with KU to develop long-term community action plan
